CLI: python tools/score_continuous_learning.py --metrics PATH --truth PATH --queries PATH --full-truth PATH --plan PATH --cell cell_a|cell_b --arm ID --start-index N --end-index N --output PATH [--observations PATH --observations-start-index N] [--incomplete]

outputs.full_scores: output.with_suffix(.full_scores.jsonl.gz); deterministic gzip mtime0; streamed per-query natural-unit/relative errors, component target diagnostics and original local-range/weight fields

boundedness: History-independent reducers for prescribed windows and regimes; at most24000 full-query rows streamed. Only declared endpoint full-query details remain in summary. No estimator/generator/RNG import or invocation.
semantics: Raw unavailable centers from mean[11]/exp(mean[5]), never convenience zeros.
Useful target passing requires reported availability plus no failed/rejected transaction.
All interval-end denominators, missing-tail censoring, first versus finite-window sustained hits, entry-required retention.
Within-target drift does not fail a retained preferred target.
Causal clean forecast, noisy innovation and filtered-fit clean voltage errors are separate.
Full16 natural-unit and positive-parameter relative errors; no nuisance tolerances.
Raw local-provisional breaches, range/hull inclusion and component-oracle diagnostics are descriptive; no coverage or runtime truth selection.
Global-index suffix joins use the original physical truth; cold/public epoch-relative times remain explicit.
review_notes: Root must retain intended frozen end_index when scoring partial runs.
Root provides --observations for noisy residual and charge summaries.
Root should provide supplemental full16 truth at first failure if absent from planned query grid; scorer flags missing full truth.
Primary validity remains the joint adapter/source/orchestrator gate; scoring alone is not runtime qualification.
